summary: This room is five under-linked entries in the BLUELINE/genAI-pipeline neighborhood plus one Shop-agent question, and the walk mostly found real, close-by relatives that simply hadn't been wired yet — not a single proposal here required reaching. The strongest thing the walk surfaced is that "Block It in Blender, Ink It in genAI" (0 inbound) and "GenAI Camera" (1 inbound) are the same pipeline told twice — one offline/batch, one live/streaming — and nothing pointed between them. The rest of the finds are entries that already talk *about* their neighbor in prose or forward_vector (Figure Rig's "downstream recipe," Shopkeeper as the literal subject of the personification question, Loudon Live Post-producer explicitly deferred-to by name) but never closed the loop in frontmatter. Depth over coverage held: several hop1/hop2 neighbours (Frame Designer, Kuramoto Coupling, The Scroll, Loudon Live, Quality Manifesto) were read and genuinely had nothing to add — already-saturated hubs whose existing symmetric links already cover the relation, so no forced additions there.
